records.title: Stop being the bottleneck.
records.from_state: Every decision, even small ones, waits on me.
records.to_state: My team moves without asking permission.
evidence: Two product calls shipped without my sign-off.
records.resistance: I feel guilty when I'm not in the room.

records.resistance: I don't want to be the person who ruins his mood.

confidence.reason: Agent's inference from a recurring theme; not yet confirmed by Maya.

records.title: Present to the board without a script.

records.to_state: I speak to the room and take hard questions live.

records.resistance: If I improvise, I might get a number wrong.

records.title: Name who replaces me.
